If I get a BSN (bachelors in nursing) and nurse practitioner in America would I be able to use that degree to get a job out of the country e.g. Canada?

They would love you in Canada, you can actually apply for permanent residency in Quebec if you have an BSN or LNP/RNP independent of first receiving a job offer there; you first have to register with the Canadian nurse licensing board and they will review your qualifications and if you pass, issue you permanent residency. I would also imagine that of all provinces Quebec pays the highest due to their overall economy.

I would suggest you check with the International Council of Nurses for more information. And by the way, Saudi Arabia, Sweden and China pay way way way more for US trained nurses than Canada.

Good luck!

So with Puca, if I've got this right, I give cards to people for nothing guaranteed in return. Then I just hope people want to send me cards?

Remember the goal of most people on the site is to eventually get the cards that they want. The only way to get cards is to give cards to people first, yes. So you have thousands of people all desperate to send cards so that they can get the ones they want in return. Unless you only want a single card that is really cheap (not worth the postage), you're pretty much guaranteed to have someone want to send it to you as soon as you have the points.

I've had people send me additional points just so that i could have enough so that they can send me a card. The system works.

When you receive cards, does it 'cost' you the points of that cards value? I watched the 'how to trade with pucatrade' videos but it still seems a bit odd. I take your word that it works, the thousands of people that seem to use it is testament to that.

Have you often had to wait long for cards you're after?

Can you request cards from people? (if you have enough points)

When you send a card out and the recipient marks it as 'received', you get the cards value added to your account in puca points (100 points = 1 $US, the value determined by an aggregate of a bunch of buy/sell sites). When someone sends you a card, its point value gets subtracted from your puca account. You won't get sent a card unless you have the points available in your account at the time.

Most of the time people want to send you cards, so you don't have to wait long.

You don't so much request cards from people, as create a list in your account with the cards that you are after. If someone has a card that you are after and you have the points for it available, they initiate the trade and the points are deducted from your account. When you get the card and mark it 'received', they then get the cards value credited to their account in points.

Hope that helps.
